INSERT INTO KEPQTDT( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, LEAD_TIME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, SEL_USER_ID, SEL_USER_NAME, SEL_USER_TEL, STOA_LIST_PRICE, STOA_DATE, STOA_TIME, ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, ATOS_TARGET_PRICE, ITEM_QTY, STOA_REMARK, IMAGE_KEY, BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, BID_SUCCESS_CODE, KEP_PRICE, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE, ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG, TRG_SKIP_FLAG, ATOB_SEND_FLAG, ATOB_DATE, ATOB_TIME, BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, BID_SUCCESS_REASON, BID_SUCCESS_DATM ) ( SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, (A.REVISION+1) AS REVISION, A.AGENT, A.AGENT_REVISION, CASE WHEN A.AGENT_REVISION = (SELECT MAX(AGENT_REVISION) FROM KEPQTDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND QUOTATION_NO = A.QUOTATION_NO AND QUOTATION_SEQ = A.QUOTATION_SEQ AND REVISION = A.REVISION AND AGENT = A.AGENT ) THEN 'C' ELSE 'O' END AS STATUS, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.UNIT_MEASURE, A.MAKER_NAME, A.ORIGIN_NAME, A.LEAD_TIME, A.ATOS_DATE, A.ATOS_END_DATE, A.ATOS_END_TIME, A.SEL_USER_ID, A.SEL_USER_NAME, A.SEL_USER_TEL, A.STOA_LIST_PRICE, A.STOA_DATE, A.STOA_TIME, A.ATOB_UNIT_PRICE, A.ATOS_TARGET_PRICE, A.ITEM_QTY, A.STOA_REMARK, A.IMAGE_KEY, A.BID_SUCCESS_FLAG, A.SELLER_IMAGE_KEY, A.BID_SUCCESS_CODE, A.KEP_PRICE, A.DSS_FLAG, A.DSS_CHOICE, A.ADMIN_CLOSE_FLAG, A.TRG_SKIP_FLAG, A.ATOB_SEND_FLAG, A.ATOB_DATE, A.ATOB_TIME, A.BTOA_NEGO_PRICE, A.BID_SUCCESS_REASON, A.BID_SUCCESS_DATM FROM KEPQTDT A WHERE (BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, REVISION, QUOTATION_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, REVISION, QUOTATION_SEQ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND QUOTATION_NO = #QUOTATION_NO# AND REF_NO = #REF_NO# ) AND ATOB_SEND_FLAG = 'Y' )
